identity: Corpse and curses; retain historical profile ID
rationale: Give the learned signature skill first opportunity when a real corpse exists. Without one, native eligibility skips Corpse Explosion and the two learned curses support hero/mercenary first kills. Keep three priority slots and the existing attack fallback. The same deterministic pack policy applies to both acts and roles, without seed-specific changes.

sourceRequirements.authority: composeCorpseExplosion from the actual source player
sourceRequirements.equipment: Canonical earned hero/merc equipment; retain every intrinsic field and paid socket
sourceRequirements.resources: Complete native source and preceding-wave HP/MP/cooldown/summon carry; no refill or injected corpse
sourceRequirements.pointSpending: No allocation, reset or new equipment change is part of this priority policy

corpsePolicy: Native deaths produce the finite battle-local corpse pool. Native eligibility, cooldown, mana, targeting and consumption remain authoritative. Do not copy corpses between waves or synthesize a first corpse.
bossPolicy: Keep each retained boss source's existing order. This pack policy neither substitutes for a boss source nor proves boss viability.
evaluation: Apply through the existing native player priority action before area admission. Record the exact source/order delta. Pack evaluation must report actual CE casts, corpse consumption, damage and mana, along with full-area entry/carry/outcomes. An order definition or learned rank is not behavioral viability.
sourceEligibility: Trash/elite repeat fixtures may use a same-act checkpoint after that act's boss reward. Reject future-act acquired gear or progress; verify exact source custody/acquisition and intended power before measuring. Boss first-attempt fixtures retain their separate pre-claim rules.
limits: Closes the two missing act-specific CE pack-order definitions only. Does not close their actual matched-level sources, power policy, native behavioral screens, population/holdout acceptance or pacing. No production mechanic changes.
